recognize_zh: 這是雙色雙融合（dual-color dual-fusion）FISH：DAPI 藍色細胞核內可見一個單獨紅點（ABL1）、一個單獨綠點（BCR），另外兩個紅綠重疊的黃白色融合訊號，即 1R1G2F 的陽性 BCR::ABL1 型態。
features: Single interphase nucleus counterstained with DAPI (blue)
One isolated red signal representing a normal ABL1 allele
One isolated green signal representing a normal BCR allele
Two red-green overlapping (yellow/white) fusion signals representing der(9) and der(22)
Signal pattern 1R1G2F, the classic positive pattern for t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization using dual-color, dual-fusion translocation probes for ABL1 (red) and BCR (green) on a DAPI-counterstained nucleus. The nucleus shows one separate red signal, one separate green signal and two co-localized red-green fusion signals (1R1G2F pattern). This reflects a reciprocal BCR::ABL1 rearrangement with fusion signals on both derivative chromosomes 22 and 9. A single nucleus is not sufficient for scoring; the result must be based on the percentage of abnormal nuclei relative to the laboratory cutoff. Findings are consistent with BCR::ABL1 fusion, t(9;22)(q34;q11.2).

ddx.dx: Variant pattern with deletion of der(9) sequences
ddx.vs: Deletion of ABL1/BCR sequences on der(9) produces a 1R1G1F pattern, whereas two fusion signals are present here.
Chance colocalization of normal signals typically yields a single fusion, while two fusions with residual separate signals in a dual-fusion assay are specific for true translocation.
A normal nucleus shows 2R2G with no fused signals.
